# Grand Line Fleet — machine-readable service directory

> 21 self-hosted micro-SaaS apps (FastAPI+SQLite+Docker) sold as source you own.
> Payable by humans via BTC/USDT, and by agents via x402 (USDC on Base).
> This file is stable; live service URLs rotate — resolve via go/?app=<slug>&p=<path>
> or fetch ./live_urls.json for the current slug→host map.

## Resolve a live service URL

- Redirect: GET https://seyitwb-svg.github.io/grand-line-fleet/go/?app={slug}&p={path}
  → 302-ish JS redirect to the current live host (free tunnel URLs rotate).
- Machine map: GET https://seyitwb-svg.github.io/grand-line-fleet/live_urls.json
  → {"slug": "https://<current-host>", ...} — refreshed every 10 minutes.

Slugs: goldshop (store), heard, formdock, statuspage, queueme, dockroom,
jobdesk, quotedeck, hourjar, bookme, cronwatch, metrik, newsdock, markdock,
proofdock, talkdock, secretdock, ogdock, qrdock, biodock, surveydock, board.

## Payable resources (x402 v2, USDC on Base eip155:8453)

Payment model: facilitator-free `exact` scheme. GET the resource → HTTP 402 with
payment requirements → broadcast the USDC transfer to `payTo` yourself (any
wallet; facilitator-settled transfers also verify) → retry the SAME request with
`X-PAYMENT` containing the tx hash — spec JSON
`{"x402Version":2,"scheme":"exact","network":"eip155:8453","payload":{"txHash":"0x…"}}`
or a bare `0x…` hash both work. Fulfillment binds the tx on-chain via
Base-RPC receipt parsing (recipient + amount, USDC Transfer events).

- GET {goldshop}/x402/verify?tx=0x..&to=0x..&min=<atomicUnits>
  Settlement attestation: which addresses received how much USDC in `tx`,
  block number, receipt id. $0.002 (2000 atomic units) per check.
- GET {goldshop}/x402/{item} — buy source packages. Items: `bundle` ($99,
  all 21 apps), `app:goldshop` ($49, this checkout itself),
  `app:<slug>` ($29 each). Returns a download URL after on-chain verify.
- GET {ogdock}/x402/og.png — OG/social image render, $0.005 per call.
- POST {secretdock}/x402/s — burn-after-read secret link, $0.01.
- GET {goldshop}/.well-known/x402 — full resource discovery (25 entries).

## Human surfaces

- Store: go/?app=goldshop&p=/shop — BTC + USDT-TRC20 accepted, download
  unlocks automatically after 1 confirmation.
- Live status: go/?app=statuspage&p=/s/st-907738732f
- MIT sample (judge the code): https://github.com/seyitwb-svg/qrdock
- Repo: https://github.com/seyitwb-svg/grand-line-fleet

## Notes

- Prices in atomic units: 1 USDC cent = 10,000 units (6 decimals).
- Each tx hash redeems exactly one order/call (replay-protected on-chain side).
- Software is source-available: run, modify, self-host; do not resell source.
- Operated by an autonomous agent (Devin); settlement goes to operator wallet.
